steps.title: Define Loader and Sound Requirements
steps.description: Examine design options for a non-blocking and visually appealing loader with digital synth sound effect.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Maintain app-meta.json with package com.moderncalculator.app and app name Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Integrate Loader XML Elements
steps.description: Modify activity_main.xml to include overlay RelativeLayout with custom themed ProgressBar and text display.

steps.title: Design Sound Synthesizer
steps.description: Create programmatic audio wave generator in MainActivity using Android AudioTrack for zero raw asset dependency.

steps.title: Establish App Startup Sequence
steps.description: Trigger the digital loader overlay on app initialization, playing a sequence of tech-style startup audio sweeps.

steps.title: Bind Reset State Sound Triggers
steps.description: Wire the 'AC' clear button to trigger a quick system reset splash loading screen and complementary synth pitch sweep.

steps.title: Validate Thread Safety
steps.description: Run background threads for programmatic audio compilation to ensure zero UI thread stuttering or blocking.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure no Java 9+ features or lambda expressions are used inside the AudioTrack thread structure.

steps.title: Optimize Layout Performance
steps.description: Perform alpha visibility blending optimizations on the loader RelativeLayout to avoid overdraw.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile, package, and test the final application targeting API level 34.
